notes.title: Loggerhead Update
notes.content:
[h3]G'day Loggerheads, an update on this project is well overdue so I wanted to share where I am currently at with the project.[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42804779/828772ec3c2372b8723c2044bf8ac364716c800f.png"][/img][/p][p]I got some excellent feedback and appreciate the positive and more constructive comments on the demo so I am working hard to address those issues as well as keep a touch of the charming nostalgic janky-ness these games are known for. [/p][p]Right now I am full steam ahead on the full game and based on feedback I have some key updates to share.[/p][p][/p][h2]What’s New in the Full Version[/h2][p][/p][h3]Controls[/h3][list][*][p]Fully reworked to be much less buggy and much more controller-friendly.[/p][/*][*][p]Options for tank controls or modern 3D movement (similar to RE1 Remake), plus D‑pad navigation for menus.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Combat & Shooting[/h3][list][*][p]Melee is faster and more fluid. You can charge attacks for high-damage tactical hits.[/p][/*][*][p]Shooting is upgraded: enemy lock-on, vertical aim, and the option for critical dismemberment—blow off heads, legs, etc.[/p][/*][*][p]Undead foes may get up again, for another go but each can be permanently vanquished—just weigh up if it is worth the ammo.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42804779/e0535ae4e5c28005ccd8f664144667389d1576bd.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Game Environment[/h3][p]The full game is much more expansive. The Boggarogga Creek campsite acts as a hub to a number of sub areas. The current areas planned for exploration are...[/p][p]	• Campsite cabins[/p][p]	• The “Boggo” Hotel (pub)[/p][p]	• Shearing Shed[/p][p]	• Church[/p][p]	• Tunnels[/p][p]	• Fisherman’s Lodge[/p][p]	• Main Highway[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42804779/56f21cb87aa6a1113508737324f177b8d3b31dfa.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Plus, expect plenty of obscure Aussie references.[/p][p][/p][h2]Behind the Scenes[/h2][p]
In 2024, I secured funding from Screen Queensland, which has helped upgrade tools and assets—though I’m still keeping my day job for now.

Thanks to this support, I’ve hired a local artist to refresh key artwork and updated the Steam capsule art.

A local musician was also brought aboard: the score is inspired by classic OzSploitation films, with horror vibes that fit the tone perfectly.

Keep Up with Us

Other places you can keep up to date I post updates on YouTube Shorts and X:

[url="https://www.youtube.com/@affordable_cat4404/shorts"]https://www.youtube.com/@affordable_cat4404/shorts[/url]

[url="https://x.com/CatAffordable"]https://x.com/CatAffordable[/url][/p][p]
Right now, I'm focused on building out the full game. Upcoming updates will bring new screenshots and a trailer to the Steam page—as well as share a bit more as production continues.

Stay tuned for more![/p][p]
Cheers Cobbers,
[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]
